title: Duration is invalid
why: Reveals whether DurationMinutes is cross-checked against the departure-to-arrival gap.

steps.does: POST …/flight with DepartureDate 2026-11-10T08:00, ArriveDate 2026-11-10T09:00 (60 minute gap) but DurationMinutes 30

expect: Rejected with a validation error that DurationMinutes does not match the departure/arrival gap; if accepted, that cross-check is missing.
